skill.name: invoice-organizer
skill.description: Organizes local invoices and receipts by extracting document details, proposing consistent filenames, sorting files into folders, and preparing a CSV summary.
skill.summary: Turn disordered invoice folders into a consistent, reviewable archive for bookkeeping and tax preparation.
skill.author: davila7

content.value_statement: Disordered invoices make bookkeeping and tax preparation slow and error-prone. This skill extracts invoice details, proposes consistent names, organizes copies, and creates an accounting summary.
actual_capabilities: Finds PDF, JPG, and PNG invoice files in a selected local folder.
Extracts vendor, date, invoice number, amount, description, and payment details when document content is readable.
Proposes ISO-date filenames while preserving original file extensions.
Organizes copied or moved files by year, category, vendor, quarter, or tax status.
Produces a CSV summary and flags documents with incomplete information.
limitations: Accuracy depends on readable text and clear scans; unclear documents require manual review.
Expense and tax categories are suggestions, not accounting or tax advice.
File renaming and movement require filesystem access and can affect existing organization.
The skill does not retrieve invoices from email services or accounting platforms automatically.

use_cases.title: Prepare Freelancer Tax Records
use_cases.description: Organize annual receipts by year and expense category, then prepare a summary for an accountant.

use_cases.title: Reconcile Monthly Business Expenses
use_cases.description: Extract invoice details, group receipts by category, and identify files that need manual review.

use_cases.title: Standardize a Multi-Year Archive
use_cases.description: Rename inconsistent files and arrange them by year and vendor while preserving original documents.

prompt_templates.title: Review an Invoice Folder
prompt_templates.prompt: Scan this folder for PDF, JPG, and PNG invoices. Report the file count and types, but do not change any files.

prompt_templates.title: Rename Invoice Copies
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract the date, vendor, document type, and description from each invoice. Propose consistent filenames and show the complete plan before copying files.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Tax Archive
prompt_templates.prompt: Organize copies by year, expense category, and vendor. Create a CSV summary with amounts and paths, then flag unclear documents for review.

prompt_templates.title: Reconcile a Multi-Year Collection
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this multi-year invoice folder. Detect duplicates by file hash, preserve originals, and generate a reconciliation CSV with missing-data flags.

output_examples.input: Organize last month's business receipts by expense category and prepare an accountant summary.
output: Created categories for Software, Office, Travel, and Professional Services.
Flagged three receipts with unreadable dates for manual review.
Prepared march-2024-expenses.csv with extracted amounts and file paths.

output_examples.input: Standardize three years of invoices by year and vendor without changing the originals.
output: Prepared a copied archive for 2022, 2023, and 2024.
Renamed each readable invoice with its date, vendor, document type, and description.
Identified duplicate files and retained the highest-quality copy.
Listed documents with missing dates or vendors in the completion summary.

best_practices: Start with a read-only scan and review the proposed organization plan.
Copy files instead of moving them until the organized archive is verified.
Review extracted amounts, categories, duplicates, and missing fields before using the CSV.
anti_patterns: Do not classify expenses as tax-deductible without professional review.
Do not rename or move the only copy of a financial document.
Do not assume modification dates are accurate invoice dates without verification.

faq.question: Which document formats can the skill organize?
faq.answer: It handles local PDF, JPG, and PNG files, including invoices, scans, screenshots, and saved email attachments.

faq.question: Does the skill preserve original files?
faq.answer: Yes. Its preferred workflow copies files and requests approval before organization changes.

faq.question: What information can it extract?
faq.answer: It can extract vendors, dates, invoice numbers, amounts, descriptions, and payment methods when the source is readable.

faq.question: Can it organize files for tax preparation?
faq.answer: Yes. It can group documents by year and category, but its classifications are not professional tax advice.

faq.question: How are unclear invoices handled?
faq.answer: The skill uses filename or file-date clues when appropriate and flags uncertain documents for manual review.

faq.question: Does it connect to email or accounting services?
faq.answer: No. It works with files already available locally and prepares a CSV for later import or sharing.
